method: Saved PDF, all raw model outputs, source-unit mappings and spans, matched context orders
decision: Do not promote 2.1.0 as a reliable answer system. Freeze as mechanical improvement with unresolved or regressed semantic outcomes.
observations: Nine quote contract failures of 2.0.0 are removed by construction; model supplies no quotation text.
The 2.0.0 insufficient-with-excerpts failure does not recur in this replay, but the contract can still fail if model supplies insufficient with selected IDs.
Passing structural validation is not semantic accuracy. Birth date and flute trials all fail abstention.
Four trials contain core useful evidence, with varying extra/fragmented context. This is not reported as four fully correct generated answers.
Two compound trials omit explicit unsupported-premise disclosure; why questions, reverse marriage/savings and summaries remain incomplete or misleading.
Punctuation segmentation exposes headers such as O . and clause/dialogue/chunk fragments as selectable units. These can weaken standalone interpretability.
Same model digest and retrieval pipeline do not isolate the effect of unit granularity, schema and prompt; all changed together.
Stage durations are local model-call measurements, not hosted latency.
next_experiment: Freeze current pipeline. Compare a small prespecified matrix of fixed evidence representations and available generation models, keeping documents/questions/options logged. Include new held-out questions; do not tune on their answers.
limitations: Single known six-page story; not held-out data.
One generation per context order, no repeated-seed study.
Small-corpus full coverage does not assess large-document retrieval.
This is an evidence view and does not evaluate a fluent synthesized answer.
